verdict.rationale: vLLM is an LLM inference and serving engine, so a unified place to manage models and configurations is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence only covers Hugging Face model loading, quantization, CLI serving and benchmarking. Nothing documents a central place to manage downloaded models, saved prompts, or per-model configurations.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can manage my downloaded models, saved prompts, and per-model configurations in one place
